newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia harvest so far 5 mln T over year-ago level.
newsitem.headline: Russia harvest so far 5 mln T over year-ago level.

text.p: Russian Deputy Prime Minister Alexander Zaveryukha told an industry meeting on Tuesday that the harvest so far was five million tonnes above year-ago levels, but he gave no figures.
He also repeated his earlier forecasts that total output would be 75-77 million tonnes.
Zaveryukha said his forecast of total 1996 grain output of 75-77 million tonnes assumed a good harvest in Siberia.
"There are complex weather conditions in Siberia," he said, adding that the Tomsk and Altai grain-growing regions had had steady rains for up to two and a half months.
Last year's drought-hit output was 63.4 million tonnes, the worst in three decades.
Other government and independent officials have forecast Russia's 1996 harvest in the range of 72-75 million tonnes.
